upstream.description: 100+ AI Agents, Agent Skills and RAG Apps - Free and Open Source.

classification.analysis: Awesome LLM Apps is a huge, actively maintained collection of 100+ hand-built, end-to-end open-source AI agents, Claude/Codex/Cursor agent skills, and RAG apps organized into categories (starter agents, multi-agent teams, always-on agents, voice agents, agent skills). Each entry is a runnable, self-contained example (Python/Streamlit apps or `npx skills add` installable skills) covering use cases like travel planning, fraud investigation, legal research, and financial analysis, built on frameworks like OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, AG2, and ADK. It targets developers and solo builders who want copy-paste-ready agent implementations or new coding-agent skills rather than a framework to learn from scratch. It is extremely popular (130k+ stars), updated weekly with new templates, and CI-gated with security/eval checks.

use_cases.title: Clone a working single-file AI agent app to bootstrap a new project idea
Install a Claude Code skill in seconds via npx skills add
Study a reference multi-agent team implementation (finance, legal, recruitment)
Find an always-on agent pattern for scheduled monitoring and briefings
